title: Gold Under the Lighthouse
turn: Candy's bet coin proves the lighthouse map is a forgery, and the crew Justin was supposed to lead now closes in on the table.

characters.name: Ruby
traits: Quiet old navigator with a bad past

infos.text: Candy needs a crew that keeps quiet.
The job is a map buried under the old lighthouse.
Ruby once sailed the lighthouse ship.
Melissa has been copying Candy's maps for years.
Candy carries a second map hidden in her boot.

beats.what: Candy pockets the coin from a sailor's bet while Ruby pushes it back across the table.
Melissa sketches maps on napkins and recalls in one line how she used to draw for coins.
Candy explains in one line that her next job needs a crew that keeps quiet.
Melissa explains in one line that the job is a map buried under the old lighthouse.
Ruby warns that the last crew who dug at the lighthouse never came back.
Justin must decide whether to sign on for Candy's dig or refuse and walk out.
opts: Turn her down and walk out

beats.what: Ruby admits in one line that she once sailed the lighthouse ship.
Melissa says flatly that she will not follow a map drawn by Candy.
Justin must decide which map to trust before the dig begins.
Candy tosses the same bet coin onto the table and the crew moves in as the forgery is exposed.
The crew Candy betrayed hunts Justin down at the next port.
